verificationNote: Every entry below was checked directly against the vendor's own pricing, quota, or campaign page — not a secondhand aggregator. Where a number could not be confirmed on the vendor page itself, the entry says so in its notes field and the value is left null.

fx.note: Used only to express US-dollar credits in RMB. Credits denominated in RMB are listed at face value.

basis.note: When a program grants a token or credit allowance rather than cash, we convert it to an RMB figure using the vendor's own list price for the models the credit covers. The 7:2:1 ratio is our standard blend of input, cached-input, and output tokens. A RMB figure is an estimate of what the credit is worth, not a cash payout.
basis.noteCn: 当项目发放的是 Token 或额度包而非现金时，我们按该额度覆盖模型的厂商官方价折算成人民币金额。7:2:1 是我们采用的标准比例：输入、缓存命中、输出 Token。这个人民币数字是该额度的等值估算，不是可以提现的现金。

programs.summary: Every account gets 10,000 Neurons of Workers AI inference each day at no charge, shared across every model on the platform. Requests go through the standard Workers or REST endpoint, so this is real API credit, not a playground allowance. Once the daily allocation is used up the free tier simply rejects further calls until the reset.
programs.summaryCn: 每个账号每天免费获得 10,000 Neurons 的 Workers AI 推理额度，平台所有模型共用这一份额度。调用走标准 Workers 或 REST 端点，属于真正的 API 额度，不是体验中心的试用次数。免费额度用完后当天再调用会直接报错，直到次日重置。
conditions: Free allocation is per day, not cumulative
Some frontier models require a paid billing method
conditionsCn: 部分前沿模型需要开通付费计费方式
programs.validity: Resets daily at 00:00 UTC (08:00 Beijing time). Unused allocation does not carry over.
programs.validityCn: 每天 UTC 00:00（北京时间 08:00）重置，当天没用完的不累积到第二天。

programs.summary: Completing real-name verification unlocks a ¥16 credit that works across the whole platform, including API calls, batch inference and fine-tuning. Pro models are covered too. The credit is valid for 180 days from the moment it lands in your account, and the program runs until the end of 2026.
programs.summaryCn: 完成实名认证即可领 1 张 16 元通用代金券，API 调用、批量推理、微调训练都能用，连 Pro 模型也覆盖。代金券自到账起 180 天内有效，活动持续到 2026 年 12 月 31 日。
programs.validity: 180 days from the date the credit is issued.
programs.validityCn: 自代金券到账之日起 180 天内有效。

programs.summary: Registering as a new Qianfan customer earns a ¥20 credit for trying the platform's mainstream models. The campaign page promotes it alongside DeepSeek-V4.1 and GLM-5.3, so the credit covers the models most people reach for first. Treat the end date as soft — the campaign page does not print a hard deadline for this specific voucher.
programs.summaryCn: 首次注册百度千帆的新用户可领 20 元代金券，用来体验平台主流模型。活动页把它和 DeepSeek-V4.1、GLM-5.3 放在一起宣传，覆盖的正是大多数人第一批想调的模型。这张券的截止日期活动页没写死，按不设硬性截止理解更稳妥。
programs.validity: Valid for 1 month from issuance.
programs.validityCn: 发放后 1 个月内有效。

programs.summary: Part of Alibaba's 云工开物 higher-education program, this gives verified students and teachers ¥300 of credit that applies to model inference, fine-tuning and deployment. There is no minimum spend to unlock it, and it stays valid for a full year. This is the largest single credit we found on any Chinese platform.
programs.summaryCn: 属于阿里云“云工开物”高校计划，面向完成实名认证的学生和教师发 300 元无门槛抵扣金，可抵扣大模型推理费用、训练费用和部署费用。领取没有门槛，有效期长达一年。这是我们找到的国内平台里单笔最大的一笔额度。
conditions: Verified Chinese university student or teacher
Does not cover Wan, HappyHorse or Omni models
conditionsCn: 需为中国高校在读学生或教师
不包含 Wan、HappyHorse 和 Omni 模型
programs.validity: Valid for 1 year from the date it is claimed.
programs.validityCn: 自领取之日起一年内有效。
programs.sourceLabel: Alibaba Cloud Bailian student program page

programs.summary: Opening Alibaba Cloud Bailian for the first time automatically grants 1,000,000 tokens of free inference per model — each model gets its own separate allowance rather than one shared pool. The window is 90 days, counted from whichever comes last: service activation, model release, or approval of your model request. Only the Beijing (华北2) region carries the free quota, and calls need a standard API key.
programs.summaryCn: 首次开通阿里云百炼会自动给各模型发放 100 万 Token 免费推理额度，每个模型各有一份独立额度，不是共用一个池子。有效期 90 天，从开通服务、模型发布或模型申请通过之日算起，以较晚者为准。只有华北 2（北京）地域有免费额度，调用需要通用 API Key。
conditions: Automatically converts to pay-as-you-go once used up
conditionsCn: 额度用完自动转为按量付费
programs.validity: 90 days from activation, model release, or approval — whichever is latest.
programs.validityCn: 自开通、模型发布或获批较晚之日起 90 天。
programs.sourceLabel: Alibaba Cloud Bailian new-user free quota doc

programs.amount: 1,000,000 tokens per language and multimodal model
programs.amountCn: 语言模型与多模态模型各 100 万 Token
programs.summary: Each Tencent Cloud master account gets one free trial bundle per model. Every language model and every multimodal-understanding model ships with 1,000,000 tokens of free quota, valid for a full year, and the platform can even claim it automatically the first time you call a supported model. Claim it through the model marketplace, the enablement console, or let it happen on your first request.
programs.summaryCn: 腾讯云主账号每个模型可领一次免费体验包。所有语言模型和多模态理解模型各给 100 万 Token 免费额度，有效期 1 年；支持的模型在首次调用时平台会自动帮你领取。可以通过模型广场、启用管理领取，也可以直接靠首次调用自动到账。
conditions: One bundle per account per model
conditionsCn: 每个账号每个模型仅可领取一次
不可转让、不可叠加、不可兑换现金
programs.validity: 1 year from the moment of claiming. Unused quota expires.
programs.validityCn: 自领取时起算 1 年，到期未使用的额度自动失效。
programs.sourceLabel: Tencent Cloud TokenHub new-user free trial doc

programs.summary: Registering on SCNet's MaaS store hands you a 10,000,000-token bundle for GLM-5.3-Flash, credited to your account in real time. The bundle is good for 30 days, is limited to new users, and is first-come-first-served. The site also notes that the exact model in the bundle can change, so read the terms before you plan around GLM.
programs.summaryCn: 在超算互联网 MaaS 特惠专场注册即到账 1000 万 Token 量包，对应模型是 GLM-5.3-Flash，上下文 1024K。量包 30 天内有效，仅限新用户，限量先到先得。页面同时说明展示的型号可能调整，别把计划完全押在 GLM 上。
conditions: Model in the bundle may change
Unused balance is deducted from paid balance
programs.validity: 30 days from claiming.
programs.validityCn: 领取后 30 天内有效。

programs.amountCn: 每个文本模型 50 万 Token
programs.summary: Registering a Volcengine account gives you a free inference quota on Ark, granted per text model. The vendor's own documentation walks through a worked example where each model carries a 500 k-token allowance shared by the master account. The quota offsets online token-billed inference only — plugins, knowledge bases and batch inference are not covered.
programs.summaryCn: 注册火山引擎账号就能拿到方舟的免费推理试用额度，按文本模型分别发放。官方文档里的示例显示每个模型有 50 万 Token（500k token）额度，由主账号下所有子账号共享。额度只能抵扣按 token 后付费产生的在线推理费用，插件、知识库和批量推理不在抵扣范围内。
conditions: Does not cover plugins or knowledge bases
Real-name verification needed to continue after the quota runs out
conditionsCn: 无法抵扣批量推理产生的 token
额度耗尽后需实名认证并手动开通推理服务
programs.validity: Shared across the master account and consumed per model. Check your console for the per-model balance.
programs.validityCn: 主账号下共享，按模型分别计算余额，可在控制台「开通管理」查看实时余量。
programs.sourceLabel: Volcengine Ark free inference quota doc

programs.summary: Rime's free plan renews $50 of speech-model usage every month, covering Prism, Mist v3, Coda v2 and Rime STT. No card is needed to start. The catch is in the terms: the free plan is intended for evaluation and development, and you may not submit caller audio, protected health information, or third-party personal data on it. Users must be at least 18 and represent that they are using Rime for business rather than consumer purposes.
programs.summaryCn: Rime 免费版每月自动续上 50 美元语音模型用量，覆盖 Prism、Mist v3、Coda v2 和 Rime STT，开箱不需要绑卡。但条款里写得很清楚：免费计划仅供评估和开发使用，不得上传客户录音、受保护的健康信息或第三方个人数据。使用者须年满 18 岁，并声明以商业而非消费身份使用。
conditions: No caller audio, PHI or third-party personal data
conditionsCn: 需年满 18 岁并以商业身份使用
不得上传客户录音、健康信息或第三方个人数据
programs.validity: Renews monthly, unused balance does not roll over.
programs.validityCn: 每月刷新，不结转。

programs.summary: Creating a Drex account credits $5 immediately, spendable against every successful POST to the inference endpoint. Drex bills per input token with no pay-as-you-go enabled by default, so the balance is what keeps your requests alive. It expires three months after sign-up, and the same account also receives a recurring $5 monthly allowance once it qualifies.
programs.summaryCn: 注册 Drex 账号立即到账 5 美元余额，可以直接抵扣推理端点的每次成功调用。Drex 按输入 token 计费，默认不开通按量付费，余额就是请求能否继续的关键。这笔新人余额注册满 3 个月后过期；同一个账号在符合条件后还会每月到账 5 美元额度。
conditions: Saving a card does not enable paid usage
Balance is consumed before any top-up
conditionsCn: 保存银行卡不会自动开通付费
余额优先于充值金额扣减
programs.validity: Expires 3 months after sign-up.
programs.validityCn: 注册满 3 个月后过期。

programs.summary: Once an account has been around a month, Drex starts adding $5 to the balance on the same day each month, on top of whatever the signup bonus gave you. The allowance is granted monthly and is subject to limits on how much free credit can be issued. Because Drex bills per input token, a $5 allowance is a meaningful amount of inference rather than a token of symbolic gesture.
programs.summaryCn: 账号满一个月后，Drex 会在每月同一天再打 5 美元额度，叠加在新人余额之上。这笔额度按月发放，且免费发放本身有额度和次数限制。Drex 按输入 token 计费，5 美元在推理上并不是象征性的一点额度。
conditions: First allowance arrives one month after sign-up
conditionsCn: 首次月度额度在注册满一个月后到账
programs.validity: Granted monthly on the anniversary of your sign-up date.
programs.validityCn: 按月发放，日期与注册日对齐。

programs.amount: ¥10 credit on the 1st of each month
programs.amountCn: 每月 1 日 10 元抵扣券
programs.summary: Ant Ling's newer billing platform pays out a ¥10 token credit on the first of every month. It replaces the older program that handed out 500,000 free tokens daily, which is the change worth knowing about: the new arrangement is smaller per month but converts into actual account balance rather than a quota you can only spend inside the product.
programs.summaryCn: 蚂蚁百灵新计费平台每月 1 日向计费账户发放 1 张价值 10 元的 Token 抵扣券。它取代了此前“每日 50 万 Token 免费额度”的旧权益——这个变化值得知道：新方案单月额度变小，但会变成账户里的实际余额，而不是只能在产品内消耗的配额。
conditions: Must be on the new billing platform
Credit applies within the current month
Mid-month upgrades do not back-pay the difference
conditionsCn: 需使用百灵新计费平台
programs.validity: Valid for the calendar month it is issued in.
programs.validityCn: 当月有效。

programs.summary: Accounts moving from the legacy billing system to Ant Ling's new one receive a single ¥20 token credit as an upgrade gift. It applies across all models, can only be spent on model inference rather than withdrawn or transferred, and is valid for 60 days from the moment it lands. New accounts skip the migration and go straight to the new platform.
programs.summaryCn: 历史计费账户升级到百灵新计费平台后，每个账户可立即获得一次 20 元 Token 消费券。适用于全部模型，只能抵扣模型调用消费，不可提现或转让，自实际到账之日起 60 天内有效。新用户无需迁移，直接使用新计费平台。
conditionsCn: 仅可抵扣模型调用消费
programs.validity: 60 days from the date the credit is issued.
programs.validityCn: 自实际到账之日起 60 天内有效。

programs.summary: Ling-3.2-flash is free for the first two weeks after launch, which the pricing page states plainly. You need an Alipay-linked account, and once the promotional window closes the model reverts to its normal price and starts drawing down your balance. Related flash models are running discounts in the same window.
programs.summaryCn: 按定价页的说法，Ling-3.2-flash 上线前 2 周限时免费，活动结束后恢复原价并开始扣账户余额。使用需要绑定支付宝。同期还有 Ling-3.1-flash 2.5 折、Ling-3.0-flash-VL 2.8 折等限时优惠。
conditions: Reverts to list price after the window closes
programs.validity: Limited-time offer — the vendor states the first two weeks after launch, not a fixed calendar date.
programs.validityCn: 限时福利——官方说的是上线前 2 周，不是固定日历日期。

programs.summary: EdgeOne Makers' free tier includes 500,000 tokens per month for calls made through its Models gateway. It is a platform hosting allowance rather than a general-purpose API credit: the quota is shared across accounts, it is meant for technical validation, and bringing your own key is billed separately. Worth using for a hosted edge function, not for building a production AI backend on.
programs.summaryCn: EdgeOne Makers 免费版包含每月 50 万 Token 的内置模型免费额度，走的是它的 Models 网关。这是平台托管的配套额度，不是通用 API 额度：额度按账号共享，定位是技术验证，自接密钥另计费用。适合拿来跑托管在边缘的函数，不适合拿它搭生产级 AI 后端。
programs.validity: Monthly allowance on the free tier.
programs.validityCn: 免费版按月发放额度。

programs.amount: 200 credits per day (+50 for linking an Aliyun account)
programs.amountCn: 每天 200 魔粒（绑阿里云账号再加 50）
programs.summary: ModelScope's credit system now covers API-Inference calls, so the daily 200 credits you get for logging in can be spent on real model inference rather than only on community tooling. Binding an Aliyun account adds 50 more per day. Typical calls cost 0.5 to 2 credits depending on model tier, so the daily grant covers a reasonable number of small requests — but it is a short-term balance, not a stockpile.
programs.summaryCn: 魔搭的魔粒体系已把 API-Inference 纳入消费场景，所以登录每天得的 200 魔粒可以直接用来调模型 API，而不只是用在社区工具上。绑定阿里云账号每天再多 50 魔粒。按模型档位，一次调用大约扣 0.5 到 2 魔粒，日常额度够跑不少次小请求，但这是短期额度，不是能囤起来的余额。
conditions: Aliyun account binding required for API-Inference
Commercial workloads should use the paid API
conditionsCn: 调 API-Inference 需绑定阿里云账号
programs.validity: Short-term credits — use them the same day. Long-term credits from community contributions are a separate 90-day bucket.
programs.validityCn: 短期魔粒当天用完；社区贡献等行为发放的长期魔粒另有 90 天有效期。
programs.modelsNote: Open-source models marked with the API-Inference lightning badge
programs.modelsNoteCn: 带 API-Inference 闪电标识的开源模型

programs.summary: The ElevenLabs free plan includes 10,000 credits every month, and the credit pool resets with each subscription period rather than accumulating. The commercial licence sits on the paid tiers, so free-plan output is limited to non-commercial use and requires attribution when published. Video generation is not part of the free allowance.
programs.summaryCn: ElevenLabs 免费档每月包含 10,000 积分，积分按订阅周期重置，不结转。商用授权在付费档上，免费档产出仅限非商业用途，公开发布时需要署名。视频生成不在免费额度内。
programs.validity: Resets each subscription period, unused credits do not roll over.
programs.validityCn: 每个订阅周期重置，不结转。

programs.amountCn: 每滚动 5 小时 12 万积分
programs.summary: During public beta, SenseNova's TokenPlan gives every account a general points pool that refreshes on a rolling 5-hour window — raised to 120,000 points in late October, with the weekly cap lifted to 1,200,000 at the same time. A separate pool exists for the Flash-Lite family. The quota is real API credit for models including DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM-5.3 and Kimi K3, and the windows reset continuously rather than on a fixed calendar day.
programs.summaryCn: 公测期间，商汤日日新 TokenPlan 的通用积分池按滚动 5 小时窗口发放，10 月 27 日起上限从 6 万提到 12 万积分，周窗口同步提到 120 万；Flash-Lite 系列另有专属积分池。这是可以真正调用 API 的额度，覆盖 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017、GLM-5.3、Kimi K3 等模型，而且窗口是滚动恢复，不卡固定日历日。
conditions: Separate pool for the Flash-Lite family
conditionsCn: 通用池周限 120 万积分
另有 Flash-Lite 专属积分池
programs.validity: Rolling windows — the 5-hour allowance replenishes continuously and the weekly cap resets weekly.
programs.validityCn: 滚动窗口——5 小时额度持续恢复，周上限按周重置。

programs.amount: Free calls to four StepAudio 3 preview models
programs.amountCn: StepAudio 3 四款预览模型限时免费
programs.summary: Stepfun is keeping the StepAudio 3 preview models free through the morning of 17 November 2026, and pricing switches to the new schedule from noon that day. The catalogue covers four variants: ASR, TTS, realtime session and audio generation. Voice cloning and voice design are billed separately, so a free call covers synthesis but not the extras around it.
programs.summaryCn: 阶跃星辰把 StepAudio 3 系列模型的限时免费政策保留到 2026 年 11 月 17 日上午 11:59，当天中午 12:00 起按新价格计费。系列包含四款：stepaudio-3-asr、stepaudio-3-tts、stepaudio-3-realtime 和 stepaudio-3-gen。音色复刻与音色设计另外收费，所以免费额度覆盖的是合成本身，周边增值服务不覆盖。
conditions: TTS and ASR are billed separately after the window
Voice cloning and voice design are billed separately
programs.validity: Free until 11:59 Beijing time on 2026-11-17.
programs.validityCn: 限免至北京时间 2026 年 11 月 17 日上午 11:59。

programs.amount: Free OCR, speech, embedding and image models
programs.amountCn: OCR、语音、向量与生图模型免费调用
programs.summary: SiliconFlow permanently lists a set of specialist models at zero cost, verified on its own pricing page: PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 for document parsing, SenseVoiceSmall for speech recognition, Hunyuan-MT-7B and Xing4.0-29B for translation, and Kolors for image generation. They are billed per model with rate limits rather than as a pooled allowance, so the practical ceiling is throughput, not budget.
programs.summaryCn: 硅基流动在自家定价页上把一批专业模型长期标成免费：PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 做文档解析、SenseVoiceSmall 做语音识别、Hunyuan-MT-7B 和 Xing4.0-29B 做翻译、Kolors 做生图。它们按模型单独计费并带限速，不是共用一个额度池，所以真正的瓶颈是速率而不是预算。
programs.validity: Ongoing — no end date published.
programs.validityCn: 长期免费，未公布结束日期。

programs.summary: SoMark's OXR document parsing model is exposed through a free API that needs no registration and no API key. The vendor states plainly that requests are queued and stability is not guaranteed, and that it is not recommended for production use. The free tier lasts until the servers hit capacity. A Python and a JavaScript/TypeScript SDK are published for it.
programs.summaryCn: SoMark 的开源文档解析模型 OXR 提供了一个免费 API，免注册、不用 API Key。官方明说请求会排队、不保证稳定性，也不建议用在生产环境，免费开放到服务器承载上限为止。仓库里同时提供了 Python 和 JavaScript/TypeScript 的 SDK。
programs.validity: Free until server capacity is reached — no fixed end date.
programs.validityCn: 免费开放至服务器承载上限，没有固定结束日期。

programs.amount: Monthly free credits during the beta (amount per account)
programs.amountCn: 测试期每月免费墨点（具体额度以账户为准）
programs.summary: Intern InkStone's beta hands out monthly credits that clear on a monthly cycle, with the exact amount set per account. The credits are drawn from a shared pool across all your API keys and are subject to combined RPM and TPM limits, so parallel key strategies do not buy extra throughput. The public page does not publish a fixed number, which is why we have left the value blank rather than guess it.
programs.summaryCn: 书生·端砚测试期每月发放免费墨点，按月清空，具体额度以账户为准。墨点在账户内所有 API Key 之间共享，调用量合并计入 RPM、TPM 限额，所以多开 Key 并不能换来更高吞吐。公开页面没有给出固定数字，我们因此没有填金额，避免编一个数出来。
conditions: Credits shared across all API keys in the account
Combined RPM and TPM limits apply
Amount is per account, not published
conditionsCn: 账户内所有 API Key 共享额度
合并计算 RPM、TPM 限额
额度以账户为准，未公开具体数值
programs.validity: Credits clear monthly.
programs.validityCn: 墨点按月清空。
